codeSystem: Official Norwegian sign number (Statens vegvesen, Håndbok N300 Trafikkskilt) as published in NVDB: object type 96 'Skiltplate', property 5530 'Skiltnummer'. The code is stored verbatim after the prefix, e.g. NO:362.50 (speed limit 50), NO:202 (give way), NO:146.1 (moose). Nothing is rewritten; a code this table does not know is passed through unchanged.
seriesBasis: The series names are descriptive, derived from the real 'Skiltnummer' entries of NVDB (the examples are verbatim from it), not quoted from Håndbok N300.

3.name: prohibitory and regulatory signs, including speed limits (362.xx)

5.name: information signs
5.reason: motorway, lane and parking information: nothing a hazard or speed alert would use

7.name: direction and wayfinding signs
7.reason: by far the largest group and of no use for hazard or speed alerts
examples: 723.72 - Kryssnummer for annen flerfeltsveg med planskilte kryss

8.name: supplementary plates and text plates
8.reason: a supplementary plate only qualifies the sign it hangs under; NVDB stores it as a separate plate, so on its own it has no meaning

9.name: markers and delineation
9.reason: background, direction and obstacle markers, edge posts
